summary: gateway-secretref-exec.sh resolves the single gateway-auth-token-*.mjs chunk of the installed OpenClaw build instead of a hardcoded build hash; no chunk or several exit 32 with gateway_token_resolver_unavailable, an empty token exits 31 with gateway_token_unavailable, the token still never reaches argv, disk or output.
reason: S24 08/11: claw_execute « Qu'est-ce que j'ai à l'agenda demain ? » returned delegation_failed reason 1 while the direct Google read completed. The OpenClaw 2026.10.9 update (S24 31/10) renamed gateway-auth-token-D8cKFnOh.mjs to gateway-auth-token-7OIpkk9l.mjs; the helper's import failed silently and every MCP owner delegation has failed since.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-gateway-secretref-exec.py
tests.evidence: With a fake OpenClaw build: the renamed chunk is used and OpenClaw receives the Gateway URL and token (value never printed); no chunk or two chunks exit 32 with a named reason; an empty token exits 31 and OpenClaw is never started; no build hash is hardcoded.
